ordering_code_anatomy.observed: MOT string = zero-padded model number (0451, 0411L, 0487E, 0351S, 0700G, 07100...) followed by option fields. 'X' conventionally = None/not selected. '*' in MOT = additional cost. Digits are NOT portable across families.

family_conventions.slot_model: Slots A (PSIO), B (CPU/COM), C/D/E (SELect I/O), Z (ACI/AVI)

cross_family_traps: Power-supply digit '4' = 48-125 V in 400-series but 125/250 V in 311L; digit '3' = 48/125 V in 311L only.
Conformal coat: X/2 in 400/300-series vs 0/1 in 700-series.
Letters A,B,C,D,G,H = DI voltage in 700-series but card type elsewhere (C = fast HC DO card; A = serial card in slot C; B = 3DI/4DO/1AO).
400-series control voltage digits 1-6 = 24..250 V; DI letters in 700-series use a different alphabet (no E/F).

select_card_subpart_numbers.pattern: 97<platform 2 digits> L <MOT slot code> <coat 0|1>   e.g. 9765L1A0 = PSIO 110-250V supply + 125V DI, no coat

evidence_examples.desc: PSIO for 5-in color touchscreen, 125 V DI
Serial comm card EIA-232/485 (Slot C only)
SEL-787-3S 3 ACI/4 AVI, 1 A winding 3 (Slot E)

select_card_subpart_numbers.trailing_underscore: '_' = conformal coating digit: 0 without, 1 with (additional cost).
select_card_subpart_numbers.caveat: The 97xx platform digits vary per relay for the same card type (e.g. RTD = 9719 on 710/751A, 9772 on 787/2411/2414; serial = 9717 vs 9751 on 2411). Needs a per-relay lookup table; only the examples above are evidenced.

relay_partno_string_note.observation: SEL-751 quick manual shows relay-stored PART NUM = 751001B5X1X7086020X (19 chars, no leading 0). Datasheet puts Slot E at MOT digits 12-13 and Slot Z at 14-15. Counting from the string WITHOUT the leading zero gives E='70', Z='86', which fits the 4-ACI Z-card codes seen in other 700-series MOTs. Leading digits '751' + '00' + PS '1B' also fit. This is a HYPOTHESIS for validation, not a fact.
relay_partno_string_note.implication: The string stored in the relay may drop the MOT's leading zero. Decide which representation the BOM must carry.
